question.fa: کشاورزان نخستین زاگرس از نظر ژنتیکی که بودند؟
question.en: Who were the first Zagros farmers, genetically?

finding.fa: چهار ژنوم ۷ تا ۱۰ هزار ساله از کرمانشاه و لرستان: جمعیتی جدا از کشاورزان آناتولی، با پیوستگی به مردم امروز ایران، جنوب آسیا و قفقاز.
finding.en: Four 7–10-thousand-year-old genomes from Kermanshah and Lorestan: a population separate from Anatolian farmers, continuous with today's Iranians, South Asians and the Caucasus.

source.title: Broushaki, F., et al. (2016). Early Neolithic genomes from the eastern Fertile Crescent. Science, 353(6298), 499–503.
Lazaridis, I., et al. (2016). Genomic insights into the origin of farming in the ancient Near East. Nature, 536, 419–424.
